game_concept: A speed quiz set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Doubling Growth: Double a size each pass with while size < goal to grow the supply cache fast.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 2: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for Procedural classification.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 260, or lives reach 0.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Doubling Growth' (Week 4 slot 12), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Mushroom Cavern'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.
topic: Introduction to C: History, Characteristics and Classification
